dish: Smoked peanut soup; bread board with pimento cheese
w: MICHELIN Bib Gourmand (Florida guide): lakeside dining room over Lake Ivanhoe named for Orlando's pineapple-growing past; Michelin singles out the smoked peanut soup and pimento-cheese bread board. Visit Orlando Michelin roundup also lists it in Ivanhoe Village.

dish: Sake pairings; kinilaw-style sashimi, tuna au poivre
address: 957 W Fairbanks Ave, Winter Park, FL 32789
w: MICHELIN Recommended (2025 new addition): Chef Michael Collantes' sake speakeasy next door to his Soseki — seasonal small plates and sashimi with sake pairings. ClickOrlando/News 6 covered Collantes and the Michelin additions.

dish: Char siu, crispy pork, roast duck bao, handmade dumplings
address: 1110 E Colonial Dr (inside Mills Market), Orlando, FL 32803
w: MICHELIN Recommended 2025 and 2026: NYC-Chinatown-style Cantonese barbecue and handmade dumplings from a husband-and-wife team inside Mills Market; Tasty Chomps (Aug 2026) reports it expanding to Minneola. News 6 covered its Michelin entry.

dish: Gyukatsu (beef cutlet) finished on a tabletop hot stone
address: 3201 Corrine Dr (inside East End Market), Orlando, FL 32803
w: MICHELIN Recommended (2025 new addition): Chef Sonny Nguyen's gyukatsu counter in East End Market, Audubon Park — diners sear their breaded beef cutlet on a hot stone. Tasty Chomps and Orlando Weekly covered its 2025 opening.

address: 30 S Magnolia Ave (Phoenix Building), Orlando, FL 32801
w: Orlando Weekly readers' Best Downtown Bar 2023, 2024 and 2025, and Orlando Magazine 2025 Dining Awards Best Cocktails: a 1920s-styled speakeasy in a historic downtown building known for its Bathtub Gin cocktails, dueling pianos and burlesque nights.

dish: Menu Confiance — weekly-changing 10-course chef's tasting (Brazilian/Portuguese/Italian/Spanish influences)
w: Orlando Magazine 2025 Dining Awards Best Restaurant (readers' choice): Chef Bruno Fonseca's intimate ~10-seat Audubon Park counter serving a trust-the-chef tasting built on local produce and fermentation. Orlando Weekly has covered it since opening, including a Jaleo collab dinner.

dish: Shrimp & cheese grits; whole fried market fish; hogfish and tilefish specials
address: 1234 N Orange Ave, Winter Park, FL 32789
w: Orlando Magazine 2025 Dining Awards Best Restaurant (readers' choice finalist alongside Foreigner and Camille): a Southern coastal fish-camp concept with a daily blackboard of Florida catches. Listed by Visit Orlando; reviewed by Scott Joseph.

dish: Fresh Florida catch of the day; citrus-forward Florida menu
address: 500 S Park Ave, Winter Park, FL 32789
w: Orlando Magazine 2025 Dining Awards Best New Restaurant: Artistry Restaurants' Park Avenue dining room (opened Jan 2025) honoring Winter Park founders, menu developed by California Grill's opening chef Clifford Pleau. Covered by Orlando Weekly and WFTV.

dish: Taglish lumpia & pork adobo rice bowl with ube horchata; Ramen Takagi ramen; Chez Les Copains raw bar
w: Two-story Ivanhoe Village food hall at The Yard (opened Apr 2025) anchored by Michelin-starred chef Michael Collantes' projects with DJ Tangalin — the rebooted Filipino counter Taglish and upstairs French brasserie Chez Les Copains — plus Ramen Rumble 2024 winner Ramen Takagi. Covered by Orlando Weekly and Bungalower.

dish: Meat-and-three: oxtails, chitterlings, fried pork chops, catfish
w: Parramore's living landmark: opened 1949 as Roser's Restaurant, it fed chitlin'-circuit musicians, athletes and civil-rights leaders; renamed Nikki's Place in 1999 and reopened in 2017 after a 2015 fire with city grants. Orlando Weekly calls it one of Orlando's most distinctive meat-and-threes; Scott Joseph reviewed it on WMFE.

dish: Cheesesteak sub with sweet potato fries
w: Family-run Maitland sub shop since 1967; nearly closed for good in Sept 2024 (News 6 covered its 'last day') before reopening weeks later (FOX 35), and Orlando Weekly readers voted it the 2025 runner-up Best Maitland Restaurant. Floridiana Magazine's 'Florida Eats' profiled its cheesesteak.
